name: VitaminZ
source:
This game is defined as a comical ADV game and is a continuation to Vitamin X.

The scene takes place five years after the original. Kitamori Manami is assigned the F class in 3rd year, the so-called "Class Z", which also has its lot of problem children...
translation:
本作是一款喜剧冒险游戏，也是《Vitamin X》的续作。

故事发生在前作五年后。北森真奈美被分配到三年级F班，也就是所谓的“Z班”；班里自然也少不了一群问题学生…
